about: Selkirk is a city in Manitoba’s Interlake on the Red River, north of Winnipeg. Known as the "Catfish Capital of Manitoba" and for steel and marine industry heritage, it serves as a regional hub between Winnipeg and Lake Winnipeg. About 10,000 people live in Selkirk.
seoSummary: Manitoba Interlake city on the Red River north of Winnipeg—catfish capital and regional hub toward Lake Winnipeg.
